texts.Clinical interpretation:
This Reitsma bivariate meta-regression jointly models sensitivity and false-positive rate across 17 studies using 2 moderators.
Moderator coefficients are reported separately for sensitivity and specificity as odds ratios with confidence intervals. Reference rows equal 1; continuous-moderator estimates describe a one-unit increase.
